title: Cracking Windows Open: Porting RADV to Win32
summary: Collabora engineers detail the technical challenges of porting RADV, the open-source AMD Vulkan driver built on Mesa/ACO compiler infrastructure, to run on Windows. The project involves adapting the Mesa gallium architecture and LLVM-based shader compilation pipeline to work with Windows kernel APIs and WDDM driver model.
problem_solved: Brings AMD's open-source Vulkan driver technology from Linux to Windows, enabling alternative driver options for Windows users with AMD GPUs.
why_valuable: Provides an open-source Vulkan driver alternative for Windows AMD users, potentially offering performance improvements and community-driven development over proprietary drivers.
